name: Bungotakada (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Bungotakada city emblem in blue, green and purple: a blue stylised numeral 3 with a green stroke and a purple oval.
history: Municipal flag of Bungotakada, a city in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 2005.

features.role: Bungotakada city emblem — a blue stylised numeral 3 with a green stroke and a purple oval
